title: The gesture routes: the marquee rule, several-layer drags, Option-drag as one step; the shared Model budgets
journeys_none: Model only: the Linux walk MJ5 (DesignGestureRouteTests); its XCUITests are select-several's J5 and copy-group's J7

slices.behavior: A marquee selects inside the frame under the pointer, a drag moves or resizes several layers as one step, an Option-drag is one Duplicate step, and hit test, edit and save stay inside their budgets on 2,000 layers.
